repositoryUntrusted: This repository is not trusted: its connections will not resolve secrets or commands.
noConnections: No connections yet. Use the + button above to add one, or create files in .spelaion/connections/ or in your personal folder.

processMonitor.title: Processes
processMonitor.choose: Select a connection to see its server activity.
processMonitor.noConnections: Add a connection to monitor its processes.
processMonitor.unsupported: Process monitoring is available for MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL and SQL Server.
processMonitor.cancelled: The connection was cancelled. Select the connection to try again.
processMonitor.selectRow: Select a process to inspect its details and SQL.
processMonitor.otherDatabase: Copy the SQL to open it in a connection to this PostgreSQL database.
processMonitor.postgresSqlLimit: PostgreSQL may truncate the SQL it reports.
processMonitor.cancelUnavailable: SQL Server can only end another session, not cancel its query separately.
processMonitor.readOnly: Process actions are unavailable on read-only connections.
processMonitor.cannotVerify: The server did not provide enough information to verify this process.
processMonitor.confirmCancel: Cancel the current query for process {{id}} ({{user}} @ {{host}}) on {{connection}}?
processMonitor.confirmEnd: End process {{id}} ({{user}} @ {{host}}) on {{connection}}? Its connection will close and any active transaction may be rolled back.
processMonitor.visibility: Other users' processes may require additional database permissions.
processMonitor.limitedVisibility: Only this connection's session is shown. Server-state permissions may be required to see other sessions and query details.

filteredHint: Some schemas, objects or columns are hidden by this connection's filter (⋯ → Configure filters)
quickFilterHint: Filter the explorer by name or tag (Ctrl+Shift+F)
quickFilterNothing: No connection, schema or loaded object matches the filter.
viewRowsHint: Double-click: view rows. Right-click: generate SQL

tableDetails.title: {{section}} of {{table}}
tableDetails.openHint: Double-click or Ctrl+Enter to open the overview
tableDetails.name: Name
tableDetails.refreshAfterReconnect: Reconnected. Refresh to load the metadata again.

newTableElement.title: Add to {{section}} of {{table}}
newTableElement.editorHint: The generated SQL opens in the editor for review.
newTableElement.name: Name
newTableElement.referencedColumns: Referenced columns (one per line, in matching order)
newTableElement.unsupported: This database cannot add this element to an existing table.

trustExplanation: Its configuration was written by someone else. If you trust it, its connections will be able to read secrets (environment variables, keychain, 1Password) and run the commands they define. A malicious repository could use this to steal secrets.
trustAdvice: Only trust repositories from your team that you know.
unknownHostPrompt: This is the first time you connect to {{host}}:{{port}} (hop {{hop}}). Check that the fingerprint matches the server's before continuing:

risk.title: Run these statements?
risk.explanation: They can lose or change data on {{connection}}. Nothing has run yet.
risk.deleteAll: DELETE without WHERE: deletes every row
risk.updateAll: UPDATE without WHERE: changes every row
risk.drop: DROP: removes the object and everything in it
risk.uncheckedWrite: DELETE or UPDATE that could not be checked for a WHERE
risk.dataChange: Changes data where the connection's type asks first
risk.execution: Runs on a connection that asks before every run
risk.executionExplanation: {{connection}} asks before running anything. Nothing has run yet.

sql.estimate: Estimated rows (from the planner, not counted)
sql.join: Generate JOIN of the {{count}} chosen tables
sql.innerJoin: Generate INNER JOIN of the {{count}} chosen tables

params.title: Query parameters
params.explanation: Numbers, NULL, TRUE and FALSE are written as they are; anything else as text, quoted for this database.

change.title: This changed since you trusted the repository
change.explanation: Someone changed {{what}} in the repository (for example in a git pull). Until you accept the change, it reads no secret and runs no command.
change.newExplanation: Someone added {{what}} to the repository after you trusted it. Until you accept it, it reads no secret and runs no command.
change.advice: Check who made the change and why (git log) before accepting, above all a new server, secret or command.

variables.title: This connection needs some personal values
variables.explanation: It uses variables that each person fills in for themselves, such as their own database user. They are asked once and saved in your user.toml, on this computer and outside the repository.
variables.advice: Not for passwords: those go in the keychain or are asked when connecting.

objectChange.cascade: Cascade: also drop what depends on it
objectChange.readOnly: The connection is read-only: the SQL can only be opened in the editor.

openByName.title: Open object by name
openByName.name: Object name
openByName.placeholder: Part of a table, view, function… name
openByName.nothing: Nothing has that name in what the explorer shows.
openByName.hint: ↑ ↓ to choose, Enter to open it and show it in the explorer.
openByName.noneConnected: Connect a connection in the explorer first: the search reads its catalog.

activeSchemaHint: For the active query tab, once it is connected to this connection
linkWithEditorHint: Link with editor: the tree shows the active tab's connection, schema and table
bookmarkHint: Click to show it in the explorer, double-click to open it
idleClosed: Closed after {{minutes}} min without use, as its connection type asks. Expand it to reconnect.
